svg.title: Mobile website experience
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: Most enquiries start on a phone. The mobile layout stacks every
section, keeps forms thumb-sized, and adds a sticky bar with
Enquire, WhatsApp and Call on every screen.
